caption: The drawing depicts a metallic pitcher with a slightly conical body that widens towards the bottom, and it is rendered in muted grey and brown tones with subtle shading showing metallic sheen. The pitcher has a round, flat-topped lid with a pronounced rectangular spout on top, and a large, curved handle attached to one side. On the opposite side of the handle, a short, cylindrical spout protrudes horizontally from near the top of the main body. In the upper left corner of the drawing, there is a small inset line sketch of the pitcher showing its dimensions in inches, indicating 2 1/4 inches for height, 3 1/2 inches for width, and a few other measurements. The main composition is centered inside a bordered rectangle on a plain beige background, and the name "Samuel Fireman Del:2594" is written in orange cursive script in the lower right corner.
